items.source: Implementation of Evaluator used to evaluate the factual accuracy of Large Language Model (LLM) responses against provided context.
items.translation: 实现Evaluator，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）的回复与所提供上下文之间的事实准确性。

items.source:
The org.sf.ai.chat package represents the bounded context for the Chat Model within the
AI generative model domain.
items.translation: org.sf.ai.chat 包代表了 AI 生成模型领域中聊天模型的限界上下文。

items.source: Evaluates the relevancy of a response to a query based on the context provided.
items.translation: 根据提供的上下文，评估响应与查询的相关性。

items.source: Uses of Evaluator in org.springframework.ai.chat.evaluation
items.translation: Evaluator 在 org.springframework.ai.chat.evaluation 中的用途
